'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****[[United Kingdom|British]] [[Secretary of State for Defence|Defence Secretary]] [[Ben Wallace (politician)|Ben Wallace]] announces that the UK is deploying a [[CAMM (missile family)|Sky Sabre]] air defence system to [[Poland]], and 100 troops to operate it as part of [[NATO]]'s response to Russian military aggression. [https://news.sky.com/story/ukraine-war-uk-deploying-ground-based-air-defence-system-and-100-troops-to-poland-12568406 (Sky News)]
***[[Panama]]'s maritime authority states that [[Russia]] has attacked three Panamanian-flagged civil vessels in the [[Black Sea]] since the Russian invasion of [[Ukraine]] began on February 24, causing one of the ships to sink. No deaths have been reported. [https://www.reuters.com/world/panama-says-three-ships-hit-black-sea-since-start-ukraine-war-2022-03-16/ (Reuters)]
***According to Ukrainian intelligence information, [[President of Syria|Syrian President]] [[Bashar al-Assad]] pledges to supply Russia with 40,000 [[mercenaries]]. [https://www.jpost.com/international/article-701597 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Boycott of Russia and Belarus]]
***[[Steam (service)|Steam]] announces that they will stop payments to [[Belarus]], [[Russia]], and [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.pcmag.com/news/steam-stops-all-payments-to-russia-belarus-and-ukraine?amp=true (PCMag)]
**The [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] votes 424–8 to suspend trade relations with Russia and Belarus following the invasion. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna20508 (NBC News)]
*[[P&O sacking of 800 staff]]
**[[DP World]]-owned shipping company [[P&O Ferries]] fires all 800 crew members across its entire fleet of [[Ferry|ferries]] and replaces them with cheaper [[Employment agency|agency workers]] who were bussed in by the company in advance. Many crew members refuse to leave their ships after being made redundant and are forcibly removed. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-60779001 (BBC News)]
*[[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] agrees to purchase American film studio [[Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer]] for [[United States dollar|US$]]8.5 billion. [https://variety.com/2022/tv/news/amazon-mgm-merger-close-1235207852/ (''Variety'')] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*An [[United Arab Emirates|Emirati]]-flagged ship sinks off the [[Iran]]ian coast in the [[Persian Gulf]] due to winds exceeding 70 km/h. '''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
*****[[India]] begins to administering its COVID-19 vaccination rollout for children aged 12 to 14 years using its homegrown [[Corbevax]] COVID-19 vaccine. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Spotlight/Coronavirus/COVID-vaccines/India-starts-COVID-jabs-for-kids-ages-12-14-with-own-vaccine (''Nikkei Asia'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record 621,328 new [[COVID-19]] cases in the past 24 hours. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20220317002651320 (Yonhap)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
***[[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[Canada]] announces that they will end their [[COVID-19 testing]] requirements for vaccinated travelers on April 1. [https://buffalonews.com/news/local/canada-to-end-covid-19-testing-requirement-for-visitors-starting-april-1/article_40a1330c-a604-11ec-bd76-4fc3e4a68ccb.amp.html (''The Buffalo News'')]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in Canada]]
****[[Health Canada]] approves the usage of the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine]] for children between the ages of 6 and 11 years. [https://www.cp24.com/news/health-canada-approves-moderna-covid-19-vaccine-for-children-aged-6-11-1.5823267 (CP24)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
***The [[Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency]] approves the use of antibody-based treatment to preventing infections  in adults with poor immune response Evushield developed by [[AstraZeneca]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/uk-approves-astrazenecas-antibody-based-covid-treatment-2022-03-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] orders the [[Federal Security Service]] to arrest [[National Guard of Russia|Rosgvardiya]] Deputy Chief General Roman Gavrilov. [https://euroweeklynews.com/2022/03/17/putin-allegedly-orders-arrest-of-top-military-chief/ (''Euroweekly News'')]
*[[Pardon of Alberto Fujimori]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of Peru]] restores a humanitarian pardon for former Peruvian President [[Alberto Fujimori]], who was sentenced to 25 years in prison for murder and corruption, previously reversed by the [[Supreme Court of Peru|Supreme Court]] three years before. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/mar/17/alberto-fujimori-pardon-prison-release-peru-court (''The Guardian'')]
*The [[Bulgaria]]n [[Ministry of Interior (Bulgaria)|Interior Ministry]] says that former [[Prime Minister of Bulgaria|Prime Minister]] [[Boyko Borisov]] has been detained by police amid a probe into [[Corruption in Bulgaria|corruption]] and the alleged misuse of [[European Union]] funds. Former Finance Minister [[Vladislav Goranov]] is also arrested as part of the operation. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/bulgarias-former-pm-borissov-detained-interior-ministry-says-2022-03-17/ (Reuters)]
